name: codex-root
description: A Codex root turn: thread-id equals session-id and resolves to the main thread.
grounding: The root guard: an equal pair is a root turn. A non-empty thread id on a root turn misroutes the root spine into derive's thread path and silently degrades the session's derived status, so the guard is behavior, not cosmetics.
notes: This is why Codex cannot be expressed as a flat first-present header list.
